function: Excluded (function): the learned SVMs only detect and classify debris from five CSI-magnitude statistics (sensing); no learned beam, waveform or resource design (pp. 3-4).
notes: Excluded for function; a learned element exists, so no_learning does not apply. The only learned components are two SVMs on mean, variance, maximum, minimum and skewness of the CSI magnitude: p. 3: "The extracted CSI features are input to a pre-trained SVM model for debris detection"; p. 4: "Both SVM models are pre-trained on Earth". The communication results (BER, pp. 8-10) come from a classical QPSK link with perfect CSI and no learned part. The adaptive MIMO, frequency and power strategies are future work through look-up tables, not learned or evaluated: p. 12: "pre-computed look-up tables (LUTs)". Borderline only if the reviewer reads area 5 as including learned sensing inside an ISAC link; the text shows no learned beams, waveforms or resources. The PDF prints no DOI, so the DOI match rests on the title and authors.
